name: Wilkes County, NC
findings: Wilkes County has 154 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wilkes County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
